decisions.reason: As a flagship service backed by a dedicated new business unit and closely tied to the firm's announced expansion into offshore and renewable shipping, management is likely to persist despite any mixed early results.
This service fits the existing maritime support offer and any weak performance can plausibly be blamed on temporary pandemic-era travel disruption, which encourages continued commitment.
Because the portal was presented as a strategic focus and supports broader, more international and data-driven client service, management has strong incentives to justify and continue the investment.

The app fits the business but lacks the same visible commitment as the flagship launches, so if uptake has been limited management is more likely to withdraw it or fold its functions into other services.
